source.author: verg
source.text: Quinquaginta intus famulae, quibus ordine longam cura penum struere, et flammis adolere Penatis; centum aliae totidemque pares aetate ministri, qui dapibus mensas onerent et pocula ponant.
source.text_original: Quinquaginta intus famulae, quibus ordine longam / cura penum struere, et flammis adolere Penatis; / centum aliae totidemque pares aetate ministri, / qui dapibus mensas onerent et pocula ponant.
source.text_english: Within were fifty maidservants, whose task it was in order to store up the long pantry and to tend the household gods with fires; a hundred others and as many male attendants of equal age, who would load the tables with food and set out the cups.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Iamque mero ludoque modus, positique quietis conticuere toris; solus quibus ordine fusis impatiens somni ductor manet.
reuse.text_original: Iamque mero ludoque modus, positique quietis / conticuere toris; solus quibus ordine fusis / impatiens somni ductor manet.
reuse.text_english: And now there was a stop to wine and sport, and those laid upon their couches for rest had fallen silent; only the leader remained, stretched out in order among them, unable to sleep.
